svg.title: Hypatia: Pharos of Alexandria
svg.desc: Attested emblem. The Pharos lighthouse appears on Roman Alexandrian coins. Its stepped silhouette represents Alexandria rather than Hypatia’s scholarly work. These coin depictions predate her lifetime; the banner is a simplified civic motif, not her personal standard. Colors follow the game palette, with darker banner ink where needed for contrast; not historical flag colors.
